hypothesis: candidate_pool: previously correlated industry peers that break upward while their high-correlation peer basket does not confirm may identify idiosyncratic demand, not generic industry beta.
interpretation: The correlation-breakdown idiosyncratic-leader source was rejected; it did not establish a distinct relation edge under the standard three-window protocol.
negative_reflection: The prior-correlation/nonconfirmation field did not clear Gate 4. The likely reason is that same-industry decorrelation still relabels short-horizon momentum or noisy peer baskets; it did not beat accepted relation comparators after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, drawdown, and concentration checks.
